name: Sales — job change trigger
description: Fires on someone starting a new role. New leaders have budget, a mandate, and ninety days to show something. The fastest sequence here, because the window closes.
audience: Anyone whose profile shows a job change in the last 90 days — the `changed_job_90d` signal on a list or Research Pack.

variants: Congratulations on the move to {{company|the new role}}, {{firstName|there}}. First ninety days are the interesting ones. Connecting to follow how it goes.
{{firstName|Hi}} — saw you'd started at {{company|the new place}}. Congratulations. Connecting; I work with people doing exactly what you've just taken on.
Thanks {{firstName|there}}. What did you walk into? Everyone I speak to in your seat inherits either no process or too much of it — rarely anything in between.
Genuine question while it's still fresh, {{firstName|there}}: what surprised you most in the first month at {{company|the new place}}?
{{firstName|Hi}} — if you're rebuilding this from scratch anyway, I can show you what the good version looks like. Fifteen minutes, no slides.
Since you're deciding what to keep and what to rip out, {{firstName|there}} — worth fifteen minutes? Easier to help before the stack is locked in.
Last one, {{firstName|there}} — you're clearly busy, which is exactly right for month three. I'll check back later in the year.
I'll get out of your way, {{firstName|there}}. Good luck with the first ninety. Shout when the dust settles.
